title: Edits, deletion, moderation and replies on channel messages
description: Needed only if Papyrus moves its people's conversations onto channels (waiting on Ryan). Papyrus messages can be edited, deleted by their author, moderated and replied to. Chatticus messages are append-only log entries in Pi sessions, so these would be new entries that change what is shown. A bot must see the correction. Done: Gherkin scenarios for each action, and for what the bot sees afterwards.
